notes: Internal TestFlight 0.17.0 (90) for user physical-device testing of the keyboard parity changes merged in PR326, including Portuguese (Brazil), English (US), accent menus, hold and slide gestures, bounded horizontal Space-drag caret movement, key accessibility metadata and sounds. Include the reviewed main integrations through PR320.
